description: Defines the OverlayWindowBuilder class for creating and displaying overlay windows in an Android accessibility service context.

classes.name: OverlayWindowBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and showing overlay windows with customizable size, position, background color, and touch interactions.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create an OverlayWindowBuilder with a specified content view.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size (width and height) of the overlay window.

methods.name: setGravity
methods.description: Sets the gravity (positioning) of the overlay window.

methods.name: setRelativePosition
methods.description: Sets the relative X and Y position of the overlay window.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the overlay window.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the overlay window with the configured properties, adding touch listener for drag movement.
